sql: WITH o AS ( SELECT o.kalshi_order_id, o.strategy, o.created_at, o.status, o.limit_price, o.quantity, o.cancel_reason, o.market_ticker FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy IN ('Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Emmsell10','Fmmsell10') AND o.kalshi_order_id IS NOT NULL AND o.created_at >= now() - interval '336 hours' ), t AS (SELECT kalshi_order_id, max(captured_at) AS last_at, min(captured_at) AS first_at, count(*) AS ticks FROM live_order_queue_ticks GROUP BY 1), j AS ( SELECT o.*, t.last_at, t.first_at, t.ticks, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(t.last_at, o.created_at) - o.created_at))/3600.0 AS rest_hours, o.quantity * o.limit_price / 100.0 AS capital_usd FROM o LEFT JOIN t USING (kalshi_order_id) ) SELECT strategy, status, COALESCE(left(cancel_reason,24),'') AS reason, count(*) AS n, round(sum(capital_usd)::numeric,2) AS capital_usd, round(avg(rest_hours)::numeric,2) AS avg_rest_h, round(sum(capital_usd*rest_hours)::numeric,2) AS capital_hours, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ticks IS NULL) AS no_ticks, min(created_at)::date AS first_day, max(created_at)::date AS last_day FROM j GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
